# Operations review

## Observations

- Riders were assigned by lottery either the old fare screen or the new one; the new-screen group filed more support contacts, so the screen is the cause.
- Of the 1,240 members polled, 310 had skipped a workout because the changing rooms were full.
- Members counted as active (at least one class booked in the previous 28 days) numbered 5,200 in October and 6,100 in March.
